$comment: HWDT Phase 2 backlog-as-code: Shift Management + Workforce Assignment Workflow. Applied by scripts/provision/provision_jira_phase2.py. Mapped to EPIC-004.
phase: Phase 2: Shift Management + Workforce Assignment Workflow (Persian-First RTL)

items.description: As a hospital nursing manager or supervisor, I can define standard shift templates for hospital departments (Morning, Afternoon, Night, On Call, Emergency) with required staff count, roles, and skills.
acceptanceCriteria: Database table shift.shift_templates created with start_time, end_time, required_staff_count, required_role, required_skill
Standard templates seeded for ICU, Emergency, Surgery, Pediatrics, NICU
GET /shift-templates and POST /shift-templates APIs
Shift templates integrated with UI for fast one-click shift creation

items.summary: Shift Instance Creation & Persian Jalali Calendar
items.description: As a supervisor, I can create, edit, view and delete shift instances for specific dates using both Jalali and Gregorian dates, with Persian shift types (صبح، عصر، شب، آنکال، اضطراری).
acceptanceCriteria: Database table shift.shift_instances created with jalali_date, gregorian_date, status, required_staff
POST /shifts, GET /shifts, GET /shifts/{id}, PUT /shifts/{id}, DELETE /shifts/{id} APIs
Shift calendar view in frontend supporting Daily, Weekly, and Monthly views with Jalali calendar and Persian weekdays (شنبه تا جمعه)
Persian digits and Jalali month length accurately computed

items.description: As hospital staff or supervisor, I can record availability, vacations, medical leaves, and training days with Persian reasons and Jalali dates.
acceptanceCriteria: Database table shift.employee_availability created with unique (employee_id, date)
POST /availability, GET /employees/{id}/availability, GET /availability APIs
Supports reasons: AVAILABLE, UNAVAILABLE, VACATION, MEDICAL_LEAVE, TRAINING
Employee self-service availability form in Persian RTL UI

items.description: As a shift supervisor, I can assign eligible healthcare personnel to shift instances, monitor required vs assigned staff count, and unassign staff if needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Database table shift.shift_assignments created with status PROPOSED, PENDING_CONFIRMATION, CONFIRMED, REJECTED, CANCELLED
POST /shifts/{id}/assign, GET /shifts/{id}/assignments, DELETE /assignments/{id}
Automatic trigger updating assigned_staff_count on shift_instances
Assignment drawer showing requirements, assigned staff, and candidate picker

items.description: The system automatically detects and prevents assignment conflicts: Rule 1 (expired credential rejection), Rule 2 (time overlap rejection), Rule 3 (unavailability/vacation rejection), and Rule 4 (required skill mismatch rejection).
acceptanceCriteria: POST /shifts/{id}/validate API returning valid boolean and detailed Persian error messages
Rule 1: Rejects assignment if professional license/credential is expired
Rule 2: Rejects assignment if employee has overlapping shift on same date
Rule 3: Rejects assignment if employee is marked as unavailable or on leave
Rule 4: Rejects assignment if employee lacks the required skill for the shift
Candidate recommendation ranking prepared for Phase 3 AI Matching Engine

items.description: As a shift supervisor or nursing manager (metron), I have a dedicated Persian RTL dashboard showing today's shifts, staff shortages, shifts needing approval, department coverage meters, and quick approval actions.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /supervisor/dashboard API calculating department coverage, shortages, and shifts pending approval
POST /shifts/{id}/approve workflow with audit event SHIFT_APPROVED
Interactive KPI cards and department coverage progress bars in Persian
Hospital roles added: HOSPITAL_ADMIN, NURSING_MANAGER, SHIFT_SUPERVISOR, DEPARTMENT_HEAD
